description.value:
The barrage is still firing. Your next Cero Metralleta this turn costs no Reiatsu Point, and you may shape it freshly as the cone or the line.

Guide §7B, Refined: "You may Sustain Cero Metralleta at the start of your next turn to fire it again in a different direction without spending a Reiatsu Point." The free shot is what the Sustain buys — without this marker the very first Cero Metralleta of an encounter was free, once every round, which is not a Sustain and quietly removed the Technique's cost.
